acceptance: Outcome ADR carries a superseded-in-part note
Proof matrix rows added for containment, deferred close and session isolation; the overclaimed caps row is narrowed or backed by a cross-process per-principal test
Load-testing executor enforces or removes the timeout, bounds its waits, and uses mono_time/elapsed_seconds
description:
Findings (develop 8ed0c64e1):
- ADR: adr-concurrency-outcome-and-ownership-contract.md section 2 still says the two executors remain quarantined and removal must preserve their public surface. #2224 removed them with no shim (adr-concurrency-public-api-reconciliation.md). Its context table still lists parallel_batch_processor.py.
- Proof matrix (docs/operations/concurrency-proof-matrix.md): phase containment and resource non-reuse have no row, though TestPhaseBoundaryGate and TestAwaitQuiescence exist. Nothing proves deferred close. Session isolation (tests/integration/test_throughput_session_isolation.py) is not cited. The row claiming durable queue and per-principal caps survive concurrent processes is backed only by a global running-cap test (tests/integration/mcp/test_durable_jobs.py:377).
- Load-testing executor (experimental/load_testing/executor.py): query_timeout_seconds (:102) is declared but never enforced; as_completed at :404 and :448 has no timeout, so one hung writer blocks the run forever; run() measures duration with time.time() (:212, :235), contrary to the monotonic-clock invariant.
